mindtraced_atomic_units: Design a one-input one-output serial 2's complementer Moore state machine.
The input (x) is a series of bits (one per clock cycle) beginning with the least-significant bit of the number.
The output (Z) is the 2's complement of the input.
The machine will accept input numbers of arbitrary length.
The total number of bits will be determined by the input signal's termination condition.
The conversion process starts when the asynchronous reset (areset) signal is deactivated (released).
The conversion process continues until the reset signal is activated (asserted).
The circuit is designed to reset its state on the rising edge of the areset signal.
The reset will clear any stored values and prepare the machine for a new input sequence.
spec_atomic_units: The module 'top_module' is a sequential circuit designed as a Moore state machine for generating the 2's complement of a serial input.
The module has four ports: 'clk' for the clock signal, 'areset' for the asynchronous reset, 'x' for the serial input bit, and 'z' for the output of the 2's complement.
The 'clk' signal triggers state transitions on the positive edge.
The 'areset' signal initializes the state machine asynchronously.
The 'x' input is sampled on the rising edge of 'clk' when 'areset' is not asserted.
The output 'z' reflects the 2's complement of the input 'x' based on the current state of the machine.
State transitions occur on the positive edge of 'clk'.
The 'areset' signal, when asserted, immediately resets the state machine to a known state.
The timing characteristics include setup time for 'x' before the clock edge and hold time after the clock edge.
The output 'z' is valid after the state transition is complete, typically one clock cycle after 'x' is sampled.
The design includes at least one register to hold the current state of the machine.
Non-blocking assignments (<=) are used in the sequential logic to update the state and output.
